name: Tofu Bulgogi

ingredients.name: extra-firm tofu, pressed and thickly sliced

steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs nearly clear. Add the measured 390 ml water, bring to a boil, cover and cook over low heat for 12–15 minutes; rest covered for 10 minutes. Meanwhile press tofu for 15 minutes and slice into thick rectangles.

Whisk grated pear, soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic and ginger into a marinade. Coat tofu slices in half the mixture and leave 20 minutes in the refrigerator. Keep the other half separate for cooking so it has not touched raw tofu.

Heat neutral oil in a wide non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Lift tofu from its marinade and sear 3 minutes per side until deep golden with browned edges. Cook in batches if needed, then set aside.

In the same pan, stir-fry onion and carrot 3–4 minutes until softened but still distinct. Pour in the reserved clean marinade and simmer 2 minutes until lightly syrupy. Return tofu carefully and turn once to coat without breaking the slices.
Fluff rice and divide among four plates. Arrange glazed tofu and vegetables beside it; scatter spring onion and toasted sesame seeds over the tofu. Serve hot while the edges remain slightly crisp.
tips: Use a clean reserved portion of marinade for the sauce. The reviewed photo shows thick seared tofu slices, onion, carrot, scallion and sesame beside plain white rice.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
